_comment: Excerpt selection for the Week 2 Phase 1A optical-flow bakeoff. Motion measured with OpenCV Farneback at 480px long side — a proxy for choosing frames only, deliberately not one of the candidate backends.

swimthrough.selection_rule: argmax of a 6-sample (~1 s) moving average of the Farneback median motion, clamped so the 8-frame excerpt and MOF's +/-2 frame context fit inside the clip
